source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Once per battle, as this unit is chosen to shoot, its models' ranged weapons gain **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)** for the rest of that phase. A token beside the unit can track that it has been used.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
